articles.title_en: Pharmaceutical demand response to utilization management
articles.title_cn: 药品需求对利用管理的响应
articles.abstract_en: Prescription drug insurance increasingly imposes prior authorization (requiring providers to request coverage before claim approval) to manage utilization. Prior authorization has been criticized because of its administrative burden on providers. The primary alternative to managing utilization is imposing out-of-pocket (OOP) payment to incentivize beneficiaries to seek lower-cost care, effectively providing beneficiaries with partial insurance. Would beneficiaries prefer indirectly paying for prior authorization through higher premiums; or would they prefer prior authorization was replaced by higher OOP costs? This tradeoff depends on how much OOP costs could be displaced by prior authorization, which depends on their relative impact on demand. I estimate the effect of prior authorization and OOP costs on pharmaceutical demand in Medicare Part D, addressing endogeneity caused by unobserved drug quality and selection into plans. Despite criticism of prior authorization, I find that Medicare beneficiaries would prefer higher premiums to pay for prior authorization, over higher OOP costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 处方药保险越来越多地实施事先授权（要求提供者在索赔批准前请求覆盖）以管理利用。事先授权因其对提供者造成的行政负担而受到批评。管理利用的主要替代方案是施加自付费用，以激励受益人寻求更低成本的护理，实际上为受益人提供部分保险。受益人会更倾向于通过更高的保费间接支付事先授权，还是更倾向于用更高的自付费用替代事先授权？这种权衡取决于自付费用能被事先授权替代多少，而这又取决于它们对需求的相对影响。我估计了事先授权和自付费用对Medicare D部分药品需求的影响，解决了由未观察到的药品质量和计划选择引起的内生性问题。尽管事先授权受到批评，我发现Medicare受益人更倾向于支付更高的保费以保留事先授权，而不是承担更高的自付费用。

articles.title_en: Reminder design and childhood vaccination coverage
articles.title_cn: 提醒设计与儿童疫苗接种覆盖率
articles.abstract_en: A major policy concern across public vaccination programs is non-compliance. Exploiting Danish population data and three national reforms in regression discontinuity designs, we document the effects of reminders for childhood vaccination coverage. Retrospective reminders are primarily effective for families with small children and when sent out close to the recommended vaccination age. Digital and postal reminders are equally effective. Prospective reminders increase timely vaccinations in later childhood and help reaching high coverage for new vaccines in increasingly complex vaccination programs. While reminders prompt additional preventive care for focal children, we find no spillovers to other health behaviors or relatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 公共疫苗接种项目中的一个主要政策关注点是不合规行为。利用丹麦人口数据和三项全国性改革，在断点回归设计中，我们记录了提醒对儿童疫苗接种覆盖率的影响。回顾性提醒主要对有幼儿的家庭有效，并且在接近推荐接种年龄时发送效果最佳。数字提醒和邮政提醒同样有效。前瞻性提醒能提高儿童后期的及时接种率，并有助于在日益复杂的疫苗接种项目中实现新疫苗的高覆盖率。虽然提醒促使目标儿童接受额外的预防性护理，但我们未发现对其他健康行为或亲属的溢出效应。

articles.title_en: The effect of primary healthcare on mortality: Evidence from Costa Rica
articles.title_cn: 初级卫生保健对死亡率的影响：来自哥斯达黎加的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses the gradual implementation of a primary healthcare (PHC) intervention in Costa Rica to examine the long-term effect of PHC on mortality. Nine years after opening a primary care center, known as a Health Area, there was an associated 13% reduction in age-adjusted mortality rate in the assigned patient population. The effect was highest among adults over 65 years of age and for those with noncommunicable diseases, such as cardiovascular-related causes of death. We also show that as Health Areas opened, more individuals sought care at primary care clinics, while fewer sought care at emergency rooms; these changes may have partially mediated the effect of the intervention on mortality.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用哥斯达黎加逐步实施的初级卫生保健（PHC）干预措施，考察PHC对死亡率的长期影响。在开设初级保健中心（称为卫生区）九年后，指定患者群体的年龄调整死亡率降低了13%%。这一效应在65岁以上的成年人以及患有非传染性疾病（如心血管相关死因）的人群中最为显著。我们还表明，随着卫生区的开设，更多个体前往初级保健诊所就诊，而前往急诊室的人数减少；这些变化可能部分中介了干预措施对死亡率的影响。

articles.title_en: The labour market returns to sleep
articles.title_cn: 睡眠的劳动力市场回报
articles.abstract_en: Despite the growing prevalence of insufficient sleep among individuals, we still know little about the labour market return to sleep. To address this gap, we use longitudinal data from Germany and leverage exogenous fluctuations in sleep duration caused by variations in time and local sunset times. Our findings reveal that a one-hour increase in weekly sleep is associated with a 1.6 percentage point rise in employment and a 3.4% increase in weekly earnings. Such effect on earnings stems from productivity improvements given that the number of working hours decreases with longer sleep duration. We also identify a key mechanism driving these effects, namely the enhanced mental well-being experienced by individuals who sleep longer hours.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管个体睡眠不足的现象日益普遍，但我们对睡眠的劳动力市场回报仍知之甚少。为弥补这一空白，我们使用来自德国的纵向数据，并利用时间变化和当地日落时间变化所引起的外生睡眠时长波动。我们的研究结果显示，每周睡眠增加一小时与就业率提高1.6个百分点和每周收入增加3.4%相关。鉴于工作时间随睡眠时长增加而减少，这种对收入的影响源于生产率的提高。我们还确定了驱动这些效应的一个关键机制，即睡眠时间较长的个体所体验到的心理健康改善。

articles.title_en: Socioeconomic status and access to mental health care: The case of psychiatric medications for children in Ontario Canada
articles.title_cn: 社会经济地位与心理健康服务获取：加拿大安大略省儿童精神科药物处方案例
articles.abstract_en: We examine differences in the prescribing of psychiatric medications to lower-income and higher-income children in the Canadian province of Ontario using rich administrative data that includes diagnosis codes and physician identifiers. Our most striking finding is that conditional on diagnosis and medical history, low-income children are more likely to be prescribed antipsychotics and benzodiazepines than higher-income children who see the same doctors. These are drugs with potentially dangerous side effects that ideally should be prescribed to children only under narrowly proscribed circumstances. Lower-income children are also less likely to be prescribed SSRIs, the first-line treatment for depression and anxiety conditional on diagnosis. Hence, socioeconomic differences in the prescribing of psychotropic medications to children persist even in the context of universal public health insurance and universal drug coverage.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用包含诊断代码和医生标识符的丰富行政数据，考察了加拿大安大略省低收入和高收入儿童在精神科药物处方上的差异。我们最显著的发现是，在控制诊断和病史的情况下，低收入儿童比看同一医生的高收入儿童更可能被处方抗精神病药和苯二氮卓类药物。这些药物具有潜在危险的副作用，理想情况下只应在严格限定的情况下给儿童处方。低收入儿童也不太可能被处方SSRIs，这是抑郁症和焦虑症在控制诊断后的一线治疗药物。因此，即使在全民公共健康保险和全民药物覆盖的背景下，儿童精神药物处方的社会经济差异仍然存在。

articles.title_en: Valuing life over the life cycle
articles.title_cn: 生命周期的生命价值评估
articles.abstract_en: Adjusting the valuation of life along the (i) person-specific (age, health, wealth) and (ii) mortality risk-specific (beneficial or detrimental, temporary or permanent changes) dimensions is relevant in prioritizing healthcare interventions. These adjustments are provided by solving a life cycle model of consumption, leisure and health choices and the associated Hicksian variations for mortality changes. The calibrated model yields plausible Values of Life Year between 154K$ and 200K$ and Values of Statistical Life close to 6.0M$. The willingness to pay (WTP) and to accept (WTA) compensation are equal and symmetric for one-shot beneficial and detrimental changes in mortality risk. However, permanent, and expected longevity changes are both associated with larger willingness for gains, relative to losses, and larger WTA than WTP. Ageing lowers both variations via falling resources and health, lower marginal continuation utility of living and decreasing longevity returns of changes in mortality.
articles.abstract_cn: 在（i）个人特定（年龄、健康、财富）和（ii）死亡风险特定（有益或有害、暂时或永久变化）维度上调整生命价值评估，对于优先安排医疗干预措施具有重要意义。这些调整通过求解消费、休闲和健康选择的生命周期模型以及相关的死亡率变化的希克斯变化来提供。校准模型得出的生命年价值在154K美元至200K美元之间，统计生命价值接近6.0M美元。对于一次性有益和有害的死亡风险变化，支付意愿（WTP）和接受补偿意愿（WTA）是相等且对称的。然而，永久性和预期寿命变化都与相对于损失的更大收益意愿以及更大的WTA而非WTP相关。老龄化通过减少资源和健康、降低边际继续生存效用以及降低死亡率变化的寿命回报来降低这两种变化。

articles.title_en: Do risk, time and prosocial preferences predict risky sexual behaviour of youths in a low-income, high-risk setting?
articles.title_cn: 风险、时间和亲社会偏好能否预测低收入高风险环境中青年的危险性行为？
articles.abstract_en: Young people in sub-Saharan Africa are particularly at high risk of sexually transmitted infections. Little is known about their preferences and even less about their association with risky sexual behaviour. We conducted incentivized economic experiments to measure risk, time and prosocial preferences in Zimbabwe. Preferences measured at baseline predict biomarker and self-reported measures of risky sexual behaviour gathered 12 months later. We find robust evidence that individuals more altruistic at baseline are more likely to be Herpes Simplex Virus Type-2 (HSV-2) positive 12 months later. Analysis by sex shows this association is driven by our sample of women. Having more sexual partners is associated with greater risk tolerance amongst men and greater impatience amongst women. Results highlight heterogeneity in the association between preferences and risky sexual behaviour.
articles.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲的年轻人尤其面临性传播感染的高风险。关于他们的偏好知之甚少，更少了解这些偏好与危险性行为的关联。我们在津巴布韦进行了激励性经济实验，以测量风险、时间和亲社会偏好。基线时测量的偏好预测了12个月后收集的生物标志物和自我报告的危险性行为指标。我们发现强有力的证据表明，基线时更利他的个体在12个月后更可能为单纯疱疹病毒2型（HSV-2）阳性。按性别分析显示，这一关联由我们的女性样本驱动。拥有更多性伴侣与男性更高的风险容忍度和女性更大的不耐烦相关。结果凸显了偏好与危险性行为之间关联的异质性。

articles.title_en: Distributionally sensitive measurement and valuation of population health
articles.title_cn: 人口健康的分布敏感测量与估值
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a measure of population health that is sensitive to inequality in both age-specific health and lifespan and can be calculated from a health-extended period life table. By allowing for inequality aversion, the measure generalises health-adjusted life expectancy without requiring more data. A transformation of change in the (life-years) measure gives a distributionally sensitive monetary valuation of change in population health and disease burden. Application to Sub-Saharan Africa between 1990 and 2019 reveals that the change in population health is sensitive to allowing for lifespan inequality but is less sensitive to age-specific health inequality. Allowing for distributional sensitivity changes relative burdens of diseases, reduces convergence between the burdens of communicable and non-communicable diseases, and so could influence disease prioritisation. It increases the value of health improvements relative to GDP.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种对年龄别健康与寿命不平等均敏感的人口健康度量，并可从健康扩展时期生命表计算得出。通过允许不平等厌恶，该度量在不需更多数据的情况下推广了健康调整预期寿命。对（生命年）度量变化的转换，可得到人口健康变化及疾病负担的分布敏感货币估值。将其应用于1990年至2019年的撒哈拉以南非洲地区，结果显示人口健康变化对寿命不平等的允许敏感，但对年龄别健康不平等的敏感度较低。允许分布敏感性会改变疾病的相对负担，减少传染性疾病与非传染性疾病负担之间的趋同，从而可能影响疾病优先级排序。它相对于GDP提高了健康改善的价值。
